insert.foreach: into animal_hospital (id, name, address, phone, latitude, longitude) values (#{hospital.id}, #{hospital.name},#{hospital.address},#{hospital.phone}, #{hospital.latitude}, #{hospital.longitude})

mapper.select: SELECT id, name, address, phone, (38.0 + (latitude - 200000) / 6367000) AS conv_latitude, (127.0 + (longitude - 600000) / 6367000) AS conv_longitude FROM animal_hospital WHERE (6371 * ACOS(LEAST(1, GREATEST(-1, COS(RADIANS(38.0 + (#{lat} - 200000) / 6367000)) * COS(RADIANS(38.0 + (latitude - 200000) / 6367000)) * COS(RADIANS(127.0 + (longitude - 600000) / 6367000) - RADIANS(127.0 + (#{lng} - 600000) / 6367000)) + SIN(RADIANS(38.0 + (#{lat} - 200000) / 6367000)) * SIN(RADIANS(38.0 + (latitude - 200000) / 6367000)) )))) <= 5
